title: InferenceResult
description: Schema for individual inference results from the teacher model.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for the input sample.

prompt_embedding.description: Embedding vector for the input prompt.

noise_level.description: Noise level parameter used during generation.

routing_label.description: Expert identifier selected by the teacher model.

velocity_vector.description: Velocity vector produced by the selected expert field.

execution_time_ms.description: Time taken to perform inference in milliseconds.
